object: Direct odd-window infimum m(L)=inf{Q_J(F)/||F||^2 : F odd, supp F in (-L/2,L/2)} of the ORIGINAL Weil form Q=E+a0||f||^2-2 sum_{log n<L} w_n C_f(log n)+P (Q061 sec. 1 normalization), computed as Ritz upper bounds in odd Legendre bases N<=320 for L in {9/4,12/5,5/2,3,4}, with an explicit-formula control Q(f)=sum_rho |fhat(gamma)|^2 on a smooth odd test function; plus the exact lemma load(v) >= |<f,Xv>|^2/(Q_I(f)-mu0||f||^2) for the shell attachment load of Q061 eq. 14, yielding load(P_S F) >= d_new(P_S F) - (Q_J(F)-mu0||F||^2) for every odd big-window F.
method: float64 Ritz eigenvalues of the original form (real-space Gamma triangle + exterior potential, exact prime translations, rank-2 poles) with explicit-formula cross-check against 600 zeta zeros; exact Cauchy-Schwarz lemma on the inherited certificate structure (P160 W=I, M>0, C_s>0)
scope: Odd real functions with zero extension; Ritz values are UPPER bounds on m(L); float64 noise floor ~1e-12; no rigorous tail control; the lemma uses only the quoted inequalities (2),(5),(6),(14) of Q061/Q063 and holds for every f in Dom Q_I, v in Dom Q_S. No statement about the full comparison (14), which is shown to be equivalent to mu0-shifted window positivity direction-wise.
difference: Prior kills LOSSY_CONSTANT (r490) and NO_BRIDGE rounds concern replacing the form by constants or importing physical norms; here the ORIGINAL form is evaluated and the constant-floor gate itself is shown to be structurally unpassable because the shell floor c_S discards the shell share of near-null (Fourier-concentrated below gamma_1=14.13) directions. This does not revive any killed route and does not assert negative Weil energy: lambda_min is at the noise floor, consistent with m(L)~e^{-gamma_1 L}>0 under RH.

stop_condition: Stop the constant-floor gate (tau<c_S) and every correctly certified finite-plus-tail version of it once one odd F with Q_J(F)/||P_S F||^2 < c_S - tau is exhibited. Do not infer negative Weil energy, RH, or failure of the full comparison (14) from this; do not promote any positive lambda_min as a certificate.
